description: Plain text completion — three NDJSON chunks of text content followed by terminator with done:true and done_reason:stop.
Text content, THEN tool_calls on the chunk PRECEDING done:true — the CLAUDE.md Ollama transport gotcha. Decoder must emit toolUseRequested when tool_calls are seen, never gate on done.
Two tool_calls in a single chunk preceding done:true — exercises both the gotcha (tool_calls before done) and parallel emission ordering.
Two text chunks then EOF without a terminator — flushOnEOF must synthesize stopReason(streamTruncated) + usage + messageStop.
Ollama OpenAI-compat /v1/chat/completions — happy text path with finish_reason:stop and the literal data: [DONE] sentinel.
Ollama OpenAI-compat tool_calls — atomic delta.tool_calls (unlike Anthropic's split input_json_delta) flushed at finish_reason:tool_calls before [DONE].
